mapper.select: SELECT c.invoice_key,c.source_type,r.legal_entity_id,r.supplier_reference,r.payable_reference FROM invoice_active_claim c LEFT JOIN procurement_payable_reservation r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.id=c.procurement_reservation_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{parameters.tenant} AND c.invoice_key IN (#{item})
